verses.text: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

segments.text: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad
thereof

notes: 97.1 multitude…: Heb. many, or, great isles

verses.text: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

segments.text: Clouds and darkness
are
round about him: righteousness and judgment
are
the habitation of his throne.

verses.text: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

segments.text: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

verses.text: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

segments.text: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

verses.text: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

segments.text: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.text: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

segments.text: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

verses.text: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

segments.text: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all
ye
gods.

verses.text: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

segments.text: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

verses.text: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

segments.text: For thou, LORD,
art
high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

verses.text: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

segments.text: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

segments.text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

segments.text: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
